DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_treasure_chest: Pick up to get a random item. The later in the match, the better.
orb_info_1: Goal. The first player to reach the kill limit (shown at the top) wins. When time runs out the leader wins; on a tie the game continues until there is a single leader.
orb_info_2: Orbs. The bars are on the right, above the shop. Grey fills by itself (faster for trailing players), blue from camps, purple from kills and assists. A full bar offers 3 upgrades; you can take the same one any number of times. Cards marked “MECHANIC” change how abilities work: autocast, double casts, traps, clones, summons. The choice window does not pop up during a fight.
orb_info_3: Center. The ring around the Overboss gives more gold and experience, but everyone there is visible. Every minute the Overboss throws orbs (more players — more orbs): stand next to one for 4 seconds to take it. Every 2.5 minutes orbs also fall at the edge of the high ground opposite each base. If a leader ahead by 5 loses first place — Overthrow: 3 purple orbs.
orb_info_4: Jungle and events. 16 camps: creeps give neutral item tokens (a new tier every 4 minutes, one item per tier). A courier chest every 90 seconds (3-second capture), the Greevil Treasurer at 5, 15 and 25 minutes.
orb_info_5: Base and consumables. The whole base gives fast regeneration, shop access and passing through units; a 3-second speed burst when you leave (if you weren't hit). Wards, smoke and dust are in slots next to the inventory: keys 5–8. Boots of Travel can be eaten (+100 speed, up to 2 times). Catch-up: revenge, leader hunt, help for trailing players.
orb_tip_bars: Tip: the orb and neutral item bars are on the right, above the shop. Hover a bar to see how to fill it.
orb_tip_boss: Tip: in 10 seconds the Overboss throws an orb into the ring. Stand next to it for 4 seconds to take it.
orb_tip_ring: Tip: inside the ring around the Overboss gold and XP come 2-3 times faster.
orb_tip_courier: Tip: a treasure courier is coming. Stand in the circle for 3 seconds to take the chest.
orb_setup_subtitle: Free for all: kills, upgrade orbs, the Overboss in the center
orb_setup_auto: Starting in %s1 s (5 s once everyone has voted)
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_axe_iron_will_: +40% status resistance while Berserker's Call lasts.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_axe_spin_Descr: +4% movement speed and +15 attack speed per Counter Helix.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_axe_hunt_Descr: +4 armor and +5% movement speed per hungering enemy.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_axe_arena_buff: +20 armor inside the arena (+20% damage after Awakening).
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_axe_free_cull_: Culling Blade can be cast again for free with +400 range.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_jugg_sanctuary: Reduced damage taken near the Healing Ward.
orb_info_tagline: Free for all: a kill race, upgrade orbs and the Overboss in the center
orb_info_6: Legendary. At level 10 choose one of your hero's 4 legendary orbs; at level 20 it awakens and gets stronger. At minute 30 — a second legendary from the remaining three. Every hero has their own purple and legendary orbs.
orb_load_orbs_d: Three orb bars: grey, blue and purple. Each full bar lets you choose an upgrade. At level 10 — your hero's legendary orb.
orb_load_center_d: The ring gives gold and experience, and the Overboss throws orbs. Capture them, but remember: everyone in the ring is visible.
orb_load_race_d: Free for all. The first to reach the kill limit wins. Revenge, the hunt and help keep trailing players in the game.
orb_tip_slots: Tip: wards, smoke and dust live in the slots next to your inventory, keys 5–8. Buy more in the shop.
orb_toast_edge_orbs: Upgrade runes fell at the edge of the high ground — one opposite each base
orb_setup_vote_hint: Every player votes. With no votes the kill goal depends on the player count and the time is 30 minutes.

orb_slot_tip_du: Dust (key %s2): %s1 left. Reveals invisible enemies within 1050 for 12 s.
orb_slot_tip_eat: Eat Boots of Travel: the boots disappear and your hero gets +100 movement speed for good. Eaten %s1 of %s2.
orb_neutral_tip: Neutral items. Tokens from jungle creeps: %s1 of %s2 — %s3. A new tier every 4 minutes; tier 5 is the last.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_fountain_Descr: On the whole base: fast health and mana regeneration, shop access and passing through units. A 3-second speed burst when you leave. Taking damage turns regeneration off for 3 seconds.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_fountain_haste: +40% movement speed. Lost when you take damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_smoke_Descript: Invisibility and +15% movement speed. Breaks near an enemy hero or when you attack.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_dust_Descripti: Invisibility removed. Invisible units are slowed by 20%.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_orb_travel_Descrip: +100 movement speed for each pair of boots eaten.
